name: 终末地工业指南
subtitle: Endfield Industry Guide
landing_text: 欢迎来到终末地工业！本手册将引导你了解终末地工业模组的方方面面，从电力系统到自动化生产，从物流网络到防御塔阵，一应俱全。$(br2)Welcome to Endfield Industry! This guide will walk you through every aspect of the mod — power systems, automated production, logistics networks, defensive towers, and more.
